verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software platform or API product, so issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any API or credentialing capability, so the exception that would make the axis apply is not triggered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
